# Athlete context for the daily coach run

Edited by the coaching chat when circumstances change. Read by daily-coach.mjs.

## Standing coaching rules (from Alberto)
- Push to the max while avoiding injury. Claude's base call historically under-loads him: plan ~10% above the base call, and say so in the changelog reason ("base call was X").
- Exception: in the last 10 days before a race, freshness wins. Race-morning TSB target +2 to +5, start-line CTL target 55.
- Indoor spin (bike) is the preferred way to add load with no impact. Bike zones: Z2 134-147bpm.
- Prescriptions are precise: reps x duration, HR in absolute bpm, recoveries stated.
- He tends to drift easy/long days into Z3-Z4 and to under-deliver easy volume: name it when it shows.
- Sleep debt (not load) is usually his limiter; HRV dips he attributes to late bedtime and dinner.
